wish: someone should make a disposable camera app that locks photos away for a random time
spec:
Takes photos with the camera (or the phone's photo picker) and locks each one on the device.
Pick a wait range, shoot, and each photo stays hidden until its own random reveal time, which is never shown.
It does not upload anything, and photos only live in this browser's storage.
notes: Camera needs permission on tap; headless test only covers the denied/fallback path.
